extraction_notes: 19 clubbed complaints were disposed of together in this order. The complainants sought execution of agreement for sale and interest/compensation under Section 18 for project 'BBJ Roma'. Since 'BBJ Roma' was unregistered and lacked sanctioned plans/CC, execution could not be ordered for the registered project 'Verona', but the authority directed the promoter to treat them as allottees in BBJ Roma or future registered projects as per layout, or alternatively give them a refund with interest at SBI MCLR + 2% as offered by the respondent. Individual principal amounts were not quantified in the order, hence null values.
